subject: CTO flight connection — proposed sponsor handover & demo playbook
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CTO flight connection — proposed sponsor handover & demo playbook

Team — quick context: StormTech's CTO (Sam) unexpectedly has a short overnight layover into SFO on Tuesday and asked if we can tighten the technical demo to a 35–40 minute window while he’s between flights. Their VP (Alicia) will be higher bandwidth on-site during the afternoon.

Given the narrow window for Sam, I propose two options we can offer and a fallback:

1) Option A — Compact CTO window (preferred): 35-minute executive-focused slot at 13:10–13:45 PT. Includes 5 minutes quick intros, 20 minutes targeted architecture + performance highlights, 10 minutes live Q&A. Karthik to lead discovery framing; Marissa to cover runtime/latency.
2) Option B — Two-part split: 40-minute sponsor brief at 09:30–10:10 PT for the VP + product team, then a 30-minute follow-up deep-dive with CTO later if he can extend his layover (contingency).
3) Fallback — Full demo rebooked to next available day; VP joins primary session, CTO watches recording.

Operational asks:
- Karthik: can you compress the slides to the 20-minute arc and produce a 2-slide appendix for follow-up technical questions?
- Marissa: assemble a pared-down infra section focusing on latency, cost, and fallback model variants (quantization/profile notes).
- Jordan: I need a one-page runbook (playbook) listing who speaks at which minute, fallback lines, and the calendar update (invite + new ics).

I attached a draft playbook and a provisional calendar invite (demo-reschedule.ics). Once we land on Option A or B I’ll send candidate times to the StormTech team.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: StormTech-demo-brief-playbook.pdf (summary, 2 pages)
Attachment: demo-reschedule.ics (calendar invite stub)

------------------------------------------------------------

From: Sam Nguyen <sam.nguyen@stormtech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CTO flight connection — proposed sponsor handover & demo playbook

Soojin — thanks for the heads up and the playbook. Sam here (StormTech CTO). I’ll be in SFO with a short layover Tuesday. Option A works best for me if you can keep it tight — I’m most interested in end-to-end latency and how you route fallback to cheaper model variants when load spikes.

If 13:10–13:45 PT is available, please confirm. If not, the earlier 11:30–12:10 PT slot also works. Alicia will be available across both.

— Sam
Sam Nguyen | CTO, StormTech
sam.nguyen@stormtech.com

------------------------------------------------------------

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Nguyen <sam.nguyen@stormtech.com>, Alicia Romero <alicia@stormtech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 12:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CTO flight connection — proposed sponsor handover & demo playbook

Sam / Alicia — great, appreciate the quick reply. We have 13:10–13:45 PT available and can lock that in as a compact CTO slot (Option A). Below is the run-of-show I suggest:

13:10–13:15 — Quick intros + agenda (Soojin)
13:15–13:35 — Architecture & latency deep-dive (Marissa)
13:35–13:40 — Cost & routing fallback (Karthik)
13:40–13:45 — Live Q&A and next steps (All)

Jordan has mocked up the playbook; I’m attaching the trimmed version for your visibility. We’ll keep the demo live and concise — if we hit a hard stop for flight boarding we’ll handoff to Alicia for the broader product conversation.

I’m sending a calendar invite now; please accept if this works. If anything changes on your end we’ll pivot to the split option and schedule the VP session earlier as discussed.

— Soojin

Attachment: StormTech-demo-brief-playbook.pdf (updated trimmed)
Attachment: demo-reschedule.ics

------------------------------------------------------------

From: Alicia Romero <alicia@stormtech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Sam Nguyen <sam.nguyen@stormtech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CTO flight connection — proposed sponsor handover & demo playbook

Thanks Soojin — confirmed and accepted the invite. Appreciate the tight runbook; sounds good to me. Sam: I’ll plan to step in if we need to extend. Looking forward to a crisp session.

— Alicia
Alicia Romero | VP Product, StormTech
alicia@stormtech.com

Notes: calendar invite accepted at 16:45 PT; Jordan to circulate final one-page runbook before 09:00 PT on Tuesday.
